method: Focused primary-source review, 27 October 2026: USENIX/OSDI proceedings, NeurIPS proceedings, original arXiv manuscripts and an archived original IEEE paper. Queries concerned prefill/decode latency, feedback-based recovery, focused repair/validation and least privilege. Official Ollama and Playwright documentation was checked separately for implementation capabilities. No benchmark results are transferred to Mini Hivo.

papers.title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
papers.venue: 18th USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation (OSDI 24), pages 117–134
papers.mechanism: Separate expensive prefill from sequential decode; chunked-prefill GPU scheduling reduces interference.
papers.authors_evidence: Authors report 2.6x Mistral-7B serving capacity on A100 versus vLLM and other multi-GPU experiments. These are their workloads and hardware.
papers.limitations: GPU batching scheduler; not an Ollama CPU client timeout repair.
papers.adaptation: Adapt phase-aware measurement and a bounded progressing Specifier response. Do not import scheduler, alter GPU settings or claim comparable speedup. Existing 1651-token prefill plus decode exceeded the original client boundary.
papers.cost_safety_tests: No training/dependency; bounded buffering and local metadata; 360-second total, 120-second idle, 8 MiB cap, complete response admission. Deterministic slow-clock, timeout and cancellation tests. Additional allowed latency is a cost, not a performance improvement.

papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.identifier: arXiv:2303.11366; proceedings author list used here
papers.mechanism: Reflect on evaluation feedback and retain episodic verbal feedback across trials.
papers.authors_evidence: Authors report 91% HumanEval pass@1, versus their cited 80% GPT-4 baseline; also evaluate decision-making/reasoning and feedback ablations.
papers.limitations: Feedback may be wrong; extra inference/trials cost time. No guarantee of scope, authority or exact artifacts.
papers.adaptation: Feedback interpretation must distinguish refused inspection from failed output before invoking repair. Use deterministic current-byte/proof checking for known literal obligations; do not add a costly model-reflection loop or treat a narrative strategy label as authority.
papers.cost_safety_tests: No model changes or episodic subsystem added. Bounded native readbacks complement existing Worker; wrong-byte/stale-proof negatives and real ROOT recovery test validate our adaptation. Full Reflexion architecture rejected for local latency and unnecessary complexity.

papers.title: The Protection of Information in Computer Systems
papers.mechanism: Least privilege, fail-safe defaults and complete mediation.
papers.authors_evidence: Architectural/tutorial analysis and historical protection-system examples; not an agent benchmark or randomized empirical performance result.
papers.limitations: Design principles do not select tool schemas or prove this implementation secure.
papers.adaptation: Project Falsifier paths to actual local authority and keep dispatch guards. Preserve goal-anchor validation; repair caller identity propagation. Refuse installer commands and disable npx implicit downloads. Browser fallback uses installed channels and isolated profiles only.
papers.cost_safety_tests: No training/infrastructure; small scope/anchor checks. Test forged/stale proofs, real goal drift, refusal before subprocess, legitimate npx verification and installed-browser failure fallback.

papers.title: Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
papers.mechanism: Separate localization, repair and independent patch validation instead of open-ended model-driven tool exploration.
papers.authors_evidence: Authors report 96 fixes (32%) on SWE-bench Lite and average $0.70 cost under their setup, with localization/validation ablations.
papers.limitations: Repository repair benchmark differs from creation tasks, recursive ownership and gemma4 CPU execution.
papers.adaptation: Localize the actual failed gate before mutation. Current correct bytes plus independent proof need inspection recovery, not another write. Keep existing recursive scheduler and final gates; do not replace Mini Hivo with Agentless.
papers.cost_safety_tests: No framework/model/dependency added. Native checks avoid extra reflection calls. Compare retained controlled recovery with historical redundant Builder/Repairer writes; genuine reliability remains separately measured.

rejected_or_deferred: Global timeout/budget inflation: expands every failure window without addressing phase or output admission.
GPU scheduler/framework import or model replacement: unsupported by this CPU local deployment and unnecessary for controller defects.
Full model-reflection retry loop: adds inference cost and cannot grant authority or override exact-byte evidence.
Enabling integrated GPU automatically: requires separate capacity/compatibility measurement and host configuration authorization.
Installing browsers from Builder run_command: dependency/environment mutation is outside verification authority.
Blanket suppression of Falsifier failures: would hide counterexamples. Only an exact refused out-of-scope probe with complete current local proof is discharged.
Global streaming expansion to tool-using roles: deferred; current wire admission tests do not establish every model-specific fragmented tool-call format. Builder latency is still disclosed.
